input.file_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Metropolitan Museum Inventory Data Standardization Script This script performs data cleaning and standardization on the Met Museum inventory TSV file. FIXITY VERIFICATION (MD5 Checksums): ===================================== INPUT FILE CHECKSUM: met_inventory.tsv: 6ec5bfc2d979ad12eb3343149beb8617 Expected OUTPUT FILE CHECKSUM (for verification): met_inventory_standardized.tsv: [Generated during execution] TRANSFORMATIONS APPLIED: ========================= 1. Fill missing Object Date values with "Unknown" 2. Fill missing Title values with "Untitled" 3. Decode HTML entities in all text fields 4. Standardize date notation: - B.C. → BCE - BC → BCE - A.C. → CE - A.H. → AH - "circa" → "ca." 5. Normalize dash characters (en-dash, em-dash → standard hyphen) 6. Remove extra whitespace from all fields 7. Standardize column names to snake_case format 8. Write output with proper quoting USAGE: ====== python3 standardize_met_inventory.py EXAMPLE: ======== python3 standardize_met_inventory.py met_inventory.tsv met_inventory_standardized.tsv """ import pandas as pd import re import html import hashlib import sys from pathlib import Path from datetime import datetime # ============================================================================ # UTILITY FUNCTIONS # ============================================================================ def calculate_md5(filepath): """Calculate MD5 checksum of a file.""" md5_hash = hashlib.md5() try: with open(filepath, 'rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(4096), b''): md5_hash.update(chunk) return md5_hash.hexdigest() except FileNotFoundError: return None def standardize_date(date_str): """ Standardize date string notation. Transformations: - B.C./BC → BCE - A.C. → CE - A.H. → AH - circa/Circa → ca. - en-dash/em-dash → hyphen - Multiple spaces → single space """ if pd.isna(date_str) or date_str == 'Unknown': return 'Unknown' date_str = str(date_str).strip() # Standardize era notation date_str = re.sub(r'\bB\.C\.\b', 'BCE', date_str) date_str = re.sub(r'\bBC\b', 'BCE', date_str) date_str = re.sub(r'\bA\.C\.\b', 'CE', date_str) date_str = re.sub(r'\bA\.H\.\b', 'AH', date_str) # Normalize dashes (en-dash, em-dash → standard hyphen) date_str = re.sub(r'[–—]', '-', date_str) # Standardize "circa" notation date_str = re.sub(r'\bcirca\b', 'ca.', date_str, flags=re.IGNORECASE) # Clean up extra spaces date_str = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', date_str).strip() return date_str def clean_html_entities(text): """Decode HTML entities and remove HTML tags from text.""" if pd.isna(text): return text text = str(text) # Decode HTML entities (e.g., < → <) text = html.unescape(text) # Remove HTML tags (e.g., , ) text = re.sub(r']+>', '', text) return text def standardize_dataframe(df): """ Apply all standardization transformations to the dataframe. Parameters: ----------- df : pandas.DataFrame Input dataframe with Met Museum inventory data Returns: -------- df : pandas.DataFrame Standardized dataframe """ print(" [1/6] Filling missing date values with 'Unknown'...") df['Object Date'] = df['Object Date'].fillna('Unknown') print(" [2/6] Filling missing title values with 'Untitled'...") df['Title'] = df['Title'].fillna('Untitled') print(" [3/6] Cleaning HTML entities from Title field...") df['Title'] = df['Title'].apply(clean_html_entities) print(" [4/6] Standardizing date notation...") df['Object Date'] = df['Object Date'].apply(standardize_date) print(" [5/6] Removing extra whitespace from all fields...") for col in df.columns: if df[col].dtype == 'object': # String columns only df[col] = df[col].str.strip() print(" [6/6] Standardizing column names to snake_case...") df.columns = [ 'Object_Date', 'Title', 'Object_Number', 'Link_Resource' ] return df def main(): """Main execution function.""" # Parse command line arguments if len(sys.argv) < 3: print("USAGE: python3 standardize_met_inventory.py ") print("\nEXAMPLE:") print(" python3 standardize_met_inventory.py met_inventory.tsv met_inventory_standardized.tsv") sys.exit(1) input_file = sys.argv[1] output_file = sys.argv[2] # Verify input file exists if not Path(input_file).exists(): print(f"ERROR: Input file not found: {input_file}") sys.exit(1) print("=" * 80) print("METROPOLITAN MUSEUM INVENTORY STANDARDIZATION") print("=" * 80) print(f"\nExecution timestamp: {datetime.now().isoformat()}") # Calculate input checksum print(f"\nCalculating input file checksum...") input_checksum = calculate_md5(input_file) print(f" Input file: {input_file}") print(f" MD5: {input_checksum}") # Read input file print(f"\nReading input file...") try: df = pd.read_csv(input_file, sep='\t') print(f" Rows: {len(df):,}") print(f" Columns: {len(df.columns)}") print(f" Missing values:") for col in df.columns: missing = df[col].isnull().sum() if missing > 0: print(f" - {col}: {missing}") except Exception as e: print(f"ERROR: Failed to read input file: {e}") sys.exit(1) # Apply transformations print(f"\nApplying standardization transformations...") try: df = standardize_dataframe(df) except Exception as e: print(f"ERROR: Transformation failed: {e}") sys.exit(1) # Write output file print(f"\nWriting standardized data to output file...") try: df.to_csv(output_file, sep='\t', index=False, quoting=1) print(f" Output file: {output_file}") except Exception as e: print(f"ERROR: Failed to write output file: {e}") sys.exit(1) # Verify output file print(f"\nVerifying output file...") if not Path(output_file).exists(): print(f"ERROR: Output file was not created successfully") sys.exit(1) output_checksum = calculate_md5(output_file) print(f" Output file: {output_file}") print(f" Rows: {len(df):,}") print(f" Columns: {len(df.columns)}") print(f" MD5: {output_checksum}") # Summary report print("\n" + "=" * 80) print("TRANSFORMATION SUMMARY") print("=" * 80) print("\nTransformations Applied:") print(" ✓ Filled missing dates with 'Unknown'") print(" ✓ Filled missing titles with 'Untitled'") print(" ✓ Removed/decoded HTML entities") print(" ✓ Standardized date notation (B.C.→BCE, A.C.→CE, circa→ca.)") print(" ✓ Normalized dashes (en-dash/em-dash → standard hyphen)") print(" ✓ Removed extra whitespace") print(" ✓ Standardized column names to snake_case") print("\n" + "-" * 80) print("FIXITY VERIFICATION") print("-" * 80) print(f"\nInput File Checksum:") print(f" Filename: {input_file}") print(f" MD5: {input_checksum}") print(f"\nOutput File Checksum:") print(f" Filename: {output_file}") print(f" MD5: {output_checksum}") print(f"\nTo verify file integrity later, run:") print(f" md5sum --check <
